Fixed the grammar's recipe-swallowing quirk (a rule WITH a recipe absorbs a directly-following conditional; the old analyzer's continue dropped every nested rule), variable-reference targets no longer become phantom regex-split symbols, .PHONY meta-directive edges removed, order-only | prereqs collected from all prerequisites nodes, $(call NAME) -> calls edges, $(VAR) -> uses edges, O(1) Map/Set dedupe. Differential 84/84 P/R 1.000; contract 34/34; shape 34 live/0 dead; corpus 7/7 clean, 273 symbols, 518 relationships, 0 errors, 0 crashes.

measured.sample: 738 tracked .md files in the scala3 language repo (its docs/, _spec/, and scaladoc/ test docs) — the same pinned repo used for the scala analyzer
measured.note: Markdown analyzer rewritten as a pure block-AST DFS + engine pre-parsed inline grammar: the tree-sitter-markdown block grammar leaves inline content opaque, so the engine pre-parses every inline node with the companion tree-sitter-markdown-inline WASM and hands the trees to the analyzer by byte offset (the vue/svelte SFC pattern). Links/images/autolinks resolve as AST nodes; ATX+setext headings -> type with hierarchy, pipe tables -> class with columns, code fences -> function with language, front matter -> namespace. Zero regexes (census 4 -> 0; autolink brackets stripped by position). Differential 59/59 P/R 1.000; contract 31/31; shape 28 live/0 dead; corpus 734/734 clean, 6673 symbols, 9112 relationships, 4 named grammar limits (|| in table cell, indented <details> in numbered lists, EOF heading without newline), 0 crashes.
